da-overclaim.referee_argument: markov-trace-frobenius-selection.md:106-111 + 2-7: 'Any non-degenerate Frobenius form on H_n(R,q) at generic q equals the Jones–Markov form τ_M block-wise' / 'the unique non-degenerate Frobenius pairing'.
